verdict.rationale: BILL's pricing page documents automatic 2-way sync with QuickBooks Enterprise and Oracle NetSuite, and the S&E product page says transactions are "categorized." But nothing shows that Spend & Expense card transactions specifically are synced, that Xero is supported, or that finance can control GL account, class, or department mappings. Missing for 10: evidence that S&E transactions sync to the ERP, Xero support, user-controlled GL/class/department mapping configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, transactions sync to QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero with GL account, class, and department mappings I control

citations.quote: Automatic 2-way sync with QuickBooks Enterprise, Oracle NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics, & more
so every transaction is controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant
